UpdateStageDescription: Moving previous server logs aside so old joins are not replayed
UpdateSourceArgs: (if not exist server\Logs\archive mkdir server\Logs\archive) & (for %f in (server\Logs\server_log_*.txt) do @(type "%f" >> "server\Logs\archive\%~nxf" & del /q "%f")) & exit /b 0

UpdateStageDescription: Moving previous server logs aside so old joins are not replayed
UpdateSourceArgs: mkdir -p server/Logs/archive && for f in server/Logs/server_log_*.txt; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f" >> "server/Logs/archive/${f##*/}" && rm -f "$f"; fi; done
